verses.text: For the music director. A psalm by David. Blessed are those who look after the poor. The LORD will rescue them when trouble comes.
The LORD will protect them and keep them alive. They’ll be blessed in the land, and he won’t hand them over to their enemies.
The LORD will sustain them on their sickbed and help them get well again.
I said, “LORD, have mercy on me. Heal me, because I’ve sinned against you.”
My enemies say cruel things about me: “When will he die and his name be forgotten?”
When one of them visits, he tells me lies. He looks for something harmful to say about me and spreads it as soon as he leaves.
Everyone who hates me whispers about me together. They imagine the worst for me.
“A terrible illness has struck him,” they say. “He’s down, and he’ll never get back up.”
Even my close friend, the one I trusted and shared my bread with, has turned against me.
But you, LORD, have mercy on me. Raise me up so I can repay them.
I know you delight in me because my enemy hasn’t triumphed over me.
You uphold me in my integrity and give me a place in your presence forever.
Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting! Amen and amen.
